biography:
Result-oriented Sales Director with broad experience from large and reputable Consultancies. Purposeful in following up Customers and Sales. Able to refer to very good Sales results in delivering Consulting services and Account Management. Responsible for negotiating several Contracts and Agreements. Extensive experience in Project Management and Project Delivery from several large and complex as well as smaller Projects in various Businesses. Basic knowledge of Banking and Insurance. Experience from Management positions and responsibility for achieving Revenue and Sales Budgets. Have planned and implemented restructuring and Organizational changes as leader and as hired consultant. Customers describe me as engaged, constructive and trustworthy, my colleagues say I am responsible, systematic and accurate. Used to work independently under changing conditions. Enjoy working with different kinds of people with different formal education and experience. One of my managers have stated the following: "Tom is focused and systematic in his work. He is an enthusiastic and energetic worker and has also been a social contributor to Business Development team."​
